paite: Huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, David in Philistia mite asual a, azou a, Gath khua leh akhotate Philistia mite asuhsak hi.
heading: David Galzohnate / (2 Sam 8.1-18)

paite: Moabte asual nawn a, Moab mite David sikhate ahong hita ua, siah ape zel uhi.
Euphrates Luipi a agam kipsak ding a David apai kawm in Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer leng Hamath chin ah asual nawn hi.
Huchi in David in kangtalai sangkhat leh sakol tungtuangmi sangsagih leh sepaih singnih amatsak a; David in kangtalai kaimi sakol tengteng thagui asattansak a, kangtalai zakhat kai ding bel ahawi hi.
Huan Damaskas a Siria mite Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer huh ding in ahong kuan ua, David in Siria mi singnih-le-sangnih athat hi.
Huchi in David in Damaskas a Siria mite lak ah asepaihte akoih a; huchi in Siria mite David sikhate ahong hita ua, siah ape zel uhi.
David in Hadadezer pawlte dangka-eng lumte alaksak a, Jerusalem ah apaipih hi.
Hadadezer khua Tibhath leh Chun a kipan David in dal tampi apua a, huaite in Solomon in dal lohte, atunnate, dal tui-um belsuante abawl hi.
Huchi in Hamath kumpipa Tou in Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer sepaih tengteng David in azou chih azak in,

Hadadezer asim a, athah ziak a chibai buk ding leh kipahpih ding in David kiang ah atapa Hadoram asawl a; Hadadezer leh Toute lah kidou sek ahi ngal ua; dangka-eng leh dangkasik leh dal tui-um belsuan chi chih leng atawisak lai hi.
Hiaite leng David in namdang azoh tengteng Edom, Moab, Ammon suante, Philistiate, leh Amalekte lak a pan dangkasik leh dangka-eng alakte toh TOUPA kiang ah alan hi.
Huai lou leng, Zeruiah tapa Abishai in Edomte singkhat-le-sanggiat Chi Phaizang ah athat hi.
Edom gam ah sepaihte akoih a; huchi in Edom mi tengteng David sikhate ahong hita uh. TOUPA'N David apaina peuh ah azousak zel hi.
Huchi in David in Israel mi tengteng tung ah vai ahawm a; ami tengteng tung ah diktattak in vai ahawm hi.
Zeruiah tapa Joab bel sepaih heutupen ahi a; Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat bel tanchin gelhpa ahi.
Ahitub tapa Zadok leh Abiathar tapa Abimelek bel siampu ahi ua, huan Shavsha bel laigelhmi ahi a;
Jehoiada tapa Benaiah bel Kereth mi leh Pelet mite heutu ahi a, David tapate bel kumpipa kim a heutu lian ahi uhi.
